planned_work.title: Safe Windows overlay index reconciliation

planned_work.title: Establish and maintain source-based C4 model
planned_work.acceptance_criteria: Provide architecture/c4/workspace.dsl and README.adoc at source ZIP root with verified TaviX components, L1/L2 context, relevant dynamic/deployment diagrams, source evidence, explicit limitations, reusable stable identifiers; validate using Structurizr CLI if available; maintain in future component changes.

planned_work.title: TaviX source-grounded developer contract and maintenance
planned_work.acceptance_criteria: Document actual manifest, archive and SDK wire boundaries and known host limitations; publish machine-readable index and code-backed tests; provide standalone hello example; preserve approval gates.

planned_work.title: Add backward-compatible TaviX game/app classification and cross-project contract
planned_work.acceptance_criteria: Validate optional type/categories in archive and local install; legacy app default, schema/documentation/examples, proposal for Tavi trusted registry/Atrium inventory and launch, exact-package regression tests and review gates.

planned_work.title: TaviX asset dependency and permission request contract
planned_work.acceptance_criteria: Validate optional assetDependencies and requested permissions in package, archive and staging; provide host-only per-pack grant subset spec, cross-project evidence, schemas, docs, C4, example and tests; no production host authority claimed.
